title: Essential surjectivity of a compatible affine chart functor
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\Omega$ an algebraically closed field, $A$ a commutative ring, $i:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and $x_U:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $x=i\circ x_U$, let $p$ and $e:\kappa(p)\to\Omega$ be the point and residue embedding of $x_U$ [def-weil-residue-field], and let $K$ be the separable closure of $\kappa(p)$ in $\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure], with inclusion $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$. Let $\mathcal N_U$ be the full subcategory of affine pointed etale neighbourhoods of $x$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods] whose structure map factors through $i$. Put $\mathcal T=\operatorname{EtaleResidueTriples}(A,p,K,\chi)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], let $D_U:\mathcal N_U^{op}\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ be global sections and $D_T:\mathcal T\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ the ring diagram. Here $\operatorname{Spec}$ and its anti-equivalence on affine schemes are as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and etale morphisms are as in [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $H:\mathcal N_U^{op}\to\mathcal T$ be a functor and $\delta:D_U\cong H\circ D_T$ a natural ring isomorphism. Assume the following formulas. For $c=(V,\bar v)$ and $t=H(c)$, require that every factorization $g:V\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ of the structure map satisfies $\delta_c\circ g^*=\alpha_t$, where $g^*:A\to\Gamma(V)$ uses the canonical spectrum/global-sections identification. Also require that $\bar v$ followed by $V\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(V)$ equals the spectrum map of $B_t\to\kappa(q_t)\to K\to\Omega$ followed by $\operatorname{Spec}(\delta_c)$. Then $H$ is essentially surjective: each triple is isomorphic to $H(c)$ for some $c\in\mathcal N_U^{op}$.

proof.text: For a triple t, use Spec B with structure map Spec α followed by i and geometric point given by B → κ(q) → K → Ω. The triple compatibility equation places this point over x, and étale composition makes the object a neighbourhood factoring through the chart. Apply δ to this object and ΓSpecIso to identify its image ring with B. The structure formula gives A-linearity. The point formula, injectivity of K → Ω and full faithfulness of Spec give compatibility with B → K. The ring isomorphism and its inverse therefore give an isomorphism of triples, establishing essential surjectivity.

theorem etale_chart_residue_triples_essentially_surjective
    (Y : Scheme.{v}) (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (A : CommRingCat.{v}) (i : Spec A ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (xU : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec A) :
    let x := xU ≫ i
    let p := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).1
    let F := (Spec A).residueField p
    let e := (SpecToEquivOfField Ω (Spec A) xU).2
    letI : Algebra F Ω := e.hom.toAlgebra
    let K := separableClosure F Ω
    let χ : F ⟶ CommRingCat.of K := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap F K)
    let Nall := (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.Elements
    let P : ObjectProperty Nall := fun c ↦ IsAffine c.1.left
    let N := P.FullSubcategory
    let Q : ObjectProperty N := fun c ↦ ∃ g : c.obj.1.left ⟶ Spec A, g ≫ i = c.obj.1.hom
    let NU := Q.FullSubcategory
    let D := (P.ι ⋙ CategoryOfElements.π (pointSmallEtale x).fiber ⋙
      Etale.forget Y ⋙ Over.forget Y).op ⋙ Scheme.Γ
    let DU := Q.ι.op ⋙ D
    let T := EtaleResidueTriples A p K χ
    let DT := etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A p K χ
    ∀ (H : NUᵒᵖ ⥤ T) (δ : DU ≅ H ⋙ DT),
        (∀ c : NU,
          let t := H.obj (op c)
          (∀ g : c.obj.obj.1.left ⟶ Spec A, g ≫ i = c.obj.obj.1.hom →
            (ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫ g.appTop ≫ δ.hom.app (op c) = t.α) ∧
          c.obj.obj.2.left ≫ c.obj.obj.1.left.toSpecΓ =
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom K.subtype) ≫
              Spec.map ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ) ≫
              Spec.map (δ.hom.app (op c))) → H.EssSurj
